readout_policy: Record readable intervals; hidden arrays never set pixel-exact numeric expectations.

F01.budget_ticks: Read actual labeled tick values and scale; do not infer linear increments from pixel spacing.

F02.interval_overlap: Evaluate visually resolvable order/overlap only; statistical significance/equivalence requires separate evidence.

F03.unit: Read original axis unit; preserve logarithmic/linear role.

F04.group_direction: Assess each legend group separately and pooled relation; no causal parameter is observed.

regions: Accept reasonable actual-source regions covering the relevant axes/marks/legend, not hidden author coordinates.
unknown: Missing quality, pairing statistics or causal experiment stays unknown; do not fill0 or invent adverse experiment.
